baseline_models.focus_anchor: The cheek-turn toward people, proud gait, and boastful predicate form one interpersonal sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberately tilted cheek withdraws the human-facing side from reciprocal presence while the gait and boast continue to advertise rank. Arrogance is therefore a broken recognition circuit, not merely an inward opinion.

activation_trace.role: The literal cheek-and-neck tilt supplies the visible act of status-laden withdrawal.
The cheek as a bodily side supplies the interpersonal surface being withheld.
The human-facing side makes people the relational direction from which the face turns.
Pride embodied in gait turns locomotion into a public rank signal.
Counting former merits supplies the verbal ledger that accompanies the bodily display.

changed_reading.before: Two adjacent etiquette rules forbid rude posture and proud walking.
changed_reading.after: One social mechanism withdraws reciprocal face while broadcasting a superior self through gait and remembered merits.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The neck, cheek, walking, earth, exultation, and gait-pride roots trace a single embodied route.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse runs from head angle through a cheek that can also image a path, into walking on the lowest shared plane. Excess joy and gait-pride bend the whole traversal, so the target is misaligned movement rather than movement itself.

activation_trace.role: The camel's crosswise course and neck mark couple upper-body angle to manner of travel.
The cheek root's path-and-tracks image turns the bodily side into a route marker.
Voluntary locomotion supplies the continuous action whose quality is being calibrated.
The low plane opposite the sky supplies the common surface of the traversal.
Joy exceeding its measure supplies instability and loss of proportion within motion.
The gait form of pride identifies the moral distortion as visible movement.

changed_reading.before: The first clause concerns the face and the second independently concerns the feet.
changed_reading.after: Character appears as one head-to-ground geometry: a skewed social orientation continues into a misproportioned track across shared earth.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final pair, especially the self-image and gait branches of خ ي ل, rereads the preceding gestures as performance.
baseline_models.mechanism: An imagined superior figure is rehearsed in gait, admired, and then ratified through competitive boasting. The body does not merely reveal a settled trait; repeated display helps manufacture the persona it claims to express.

activation_trace.role: The imagined likeness supplies the projected persona being enacted.
Imaginative semblance and ambiguity keep the displayed superiority from being treated as stable fact.
Pride in the walk gives the imagined figure a bodily rehearsal.
The exclamation of admiration supplies the applause anticipated by the performance.
Competitive preference supplies the comparison by which the persona claims superiority.

changed_reading.before: The closing adjectives name a person who simply possesses arrogance.
changed_reading.after: They expose a feedback loop in which imagined superiority is staged through movement, solicits admiration, and is stabilized by comparison and boast.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier arrogant hearer turns away and simulates an ear too burdened to receive. This sharpens the focus cheek-turn into chosen non-reception: bodily orientation is used to prevent another presence or address from registering.

activation_trace.role: The tilted cheek anchors the revised mechanism in the focus gesture.
Seeing, hearing, and sensing make interpersonal recognition the channel being closed.
Turning one's back supplies the active withdrawal that parallels the cheek-turn.
The arrogance branch names the motive joining the earlier refusal to the focus posture.
Hearing as understanding and compliance shows that reception, not acoustics alone, is refused.
Listening and accepting supply the receptive posture displaced by bodily turning.
Ear-heaviness supplies the performed blockage that completes the closure circuit.

structural_cues: 31:7 sequences recitation, turning away, arrogance, simulated nonhearing, and weighted ears.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a bodily-and-auditory refusal sequence; I infer that the focus cheek performs the same closure toward people. A live alternative is that 31:7 concerns revelation-rejection only and does not generalize to interpersonal perception.

changed_reading.before: Turning the cheek is dismissive body language.
changed_reading.after: It is a practiced technology of non-reception: the arrogant body arranges not to see, hear, or acknowledge what could answer its self-image.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is stabilized against sway and made to grow, then even a mustard-seed weight hidden within creation remains retrievable. Against that field, exultant gait can be read as renewed sway and counterfeit self-growth: conspicuous expansion that ignores both received ground and minute moral weight.

activation_trace.role: Fecund, yielding earth supplies the received field against which self-produced flourishing is tested.
Rapid growth after rain supplies the focus-side image of sudden expansion.
Fixity and rootedness establish stability as the earth's prior gift.
The branch image of strutting in one's walk unexpectedly turns prevented sway into a direct gait activator.
Growth emerging from earth supplies genuine flourishing as received emergence.
The seed branch links the smallest generative unit to the focus root used for divine love.
Measured weight makes even a tiny posture morally nonzero.
Smallness, subtlety, and concealment prevent public spectacle from defining moral scale.

structural_cues: 31:10 moves from stabilizing earth to distributing life and growth.
31:16 nests a tiny seed through rock, heavens, and earth before its retrieval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stability, sway, growth, seed, and minute weight; I infer a contrast between received flourishing and self-inflating display. The live alternative is that these creation images establish power and knowledge without specifically commenting on pride.

changed_reading.before: Earth is only the location of an ostentatious walk.
changed_reading.after: The walk jars against a stable, fecund, finely accountable earth: pride performs counterfeit growth while overlooking the weight of its smallest gesture.

context_deltas.mechanism: Gratitude recognizes benefit as received, while the later visible/hidden blessing pair includes a branch where outward possession becomes an object of boasting. The focus boaster thus misaccounts gifts as self-authored rank and selectively displays what can support that account.

activation_trace.role: The reckoning of old merits supplies the self-credit ledger being revised.
Recognition of benefit and praise of its giver supply the opposite accounting practice.
The branch image of boasting over what is outwardly possessed directly activates the focus boast.
The hidden interior keeps blessing and worth from being exhausted by displayable surfaces.

structural_cues: 31:12 repeats gratitude and makes its return accrue to the grateful self; 31:20 pairs blessings that appear with blessings that remain inward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gift-recognition and an outward-boasting branch; I infer that fakhur converts received benefit into private authorship. It may instead denote status boasting without a necessary claim about provenance.

changed_reading.before: The boaster talks too highly about personal achievements.
changed_reading.after: The boaster falsifies the provenance of good, curating visible gifts as evidence of self-made rank while ignoring their hidden and received dimensions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The parent sequence separates refusal of wrongful obedience from continued companionship, recognizable good conduct, and following a path. The focus injunction therefore preserves face-to-face human presence without requiring moral conformity: humility is durable accompaniment with boundaries.

activation_trace.role: The side turned toward a human anchors the focus as relational orientation.
The bodily side supplies the face that can remain present without conceding judgment.
The human-facing side repeats the orientation latent in the focus word for people.
Continuing company supplies proximity that survives disagreement.
Recognizable good supplies the quality governing companionship.
Following an articulated trace supplies directed moral movement rather than passive compliance.
The extended traversable road joins social accompaniment to the focus walking motif.

structural_cues: 31:15 orders non-obedience, then good companionship in worldly life, then following a returner's path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded disobedience alongside continued company and path-following; I infer that an untilted cheek embodies presence without surrender. The immediate rule concerns parents, so its extension to all people remains analogical.

changed_reading.before: Humility means yielding politely to other people.
changed_reading.after: Humility can mean staying recognizably present and companionable across principled refusal, without using moral disagreement as permission to withdraw the face.

context_deltas.mechanism: Patience holds the self through public duty, resolve persists along a path, and the next verse specifies straight, moderate, purposive gait together with reduced vocal force. The correction to proud motion is active calibration, not stillness or social disappearance.

activation_trace.role: Excessive joy supplies unbounded activation requiring measure.
Pride lodged in gait identifies the motion to be recalibrated.
Holding the self against panic supplies regulated persistence.
Remaining on course and proceeding supplies determined movement without display.
Straightness of road and walk gives the focus motion a positive geometry.
The middle between extremes supplies proportion rather than suppression.
The repeated walking root confirms that locomotion itself remains affirmed.
Deliberate reduction of force extends bodily calibration into audibility.

structural_cues: The focus is bracketed by public duty and patient resolve in 31:17, then measured gait and lowered voice in 31:19.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an imperative arc from endurance through prohibited display to measured movement; I infer that these are coordinated disciplines of force. An alternative treats each command as independent advice.

changed_reading.before: Avoid pride by making oneself small, slow, or inconspicuous.
changed_reading.after: Move and speak with purpose: sustained public action is retained, while direction, amplitude, and self-display are brought within measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later verse gives the whole face a direction of surrender toward God and pairs it with good action and a firm grasp. The focus cheek can then remain open toward people because ultimate orientation is already secured elsewhere; social availability need not become dependence on social rank.

activation_trace.role: The forbidden cheek tilt anchors the distinction between partial withdrawal and whole-face orientation.
The cheek as one side of the face supplies the horizontal social surface.
Handing over and relinquishing control supplies the face's governing surrender.
Direction and orientation turn the face into a vector rather than mere appearance.
Face-to-face encounter preserves the relational consequence of that orientation.
Holding fast supplies stability that does not have to be manufactured through prestige.
Firmness and secure construction supply the alternative ground of composure.

structural_cues: 31:22 directs the face, names good action, and then depicts grasping; its branchless ع ر و occurrence is used only as the syntactic handhold, not as branch evidence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surrendered face and secure grasp; I infer a vertical orientation that enables horizontal openness. A live alternative is that 31:22 describes faith generally and does not partition whole-face direction from cheek-level social conduct.

changed_reading.before: The verse asks for a generally modest facial demeanor.
changed_reading.after: It distinguishes orientations: a surrendered whole face can offer an untilted cheek to people without making either their approval or one's rank the source of stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic bodies run to appointed limits, a ship runs by grace, waves expose dependence, and return to land yields a moderate person. Walking on earth becomes one local course within bounded and supported motion; pride falsely narrates the traveler as self-propelled and unbounded.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary walking anchors the large-scale course analogy in the focus action.
The low terrestrial plane supplies the landward segment of the wider movement system.
Comprehensive inclusion places every celestial course under one bounded rule.
Flowing course supplies motion that continues without self-display.
An appointed temporal limit denies the fantasy of an unbounded trajectory.
The vessel moving through water supplies supported transit rather than autonomous footing.
The ship's flowing movement repeats course as a received possibility.
Interpenetrating turbulence exposes how quickly confident carriage loses control.
Dry land supplies the return to the same grounded domain as the focus walk.
Moderation after rescue supplies the proportionate landward response to dependent travel.

structural_cues: 31:29 gives every celestial runner a term; 31:31 attributes the ship's running to grace; 31:32 moves from engulfing waves to land and moderation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded cosmic motion, graced marine motion, crisis, land, and moderation; I infer that these rescale the focus walk as dependent course. The alternative is a thematic analogy only, since qasd in 31:32 describes a person rather than explicitly modifying gait.

changed_reading.before: The proud walker exaggerates social importance while crossing ordinary ground.
changed_reading.after: The walker mistakes a bounded, supported passage for self-authored mastery; measured gait remembers that every course has a medium, limit, and enabling grace.

context_deltas.mechanism: No relative can stand in for another, worldly life deceives through attractive appearance, and no self knows tomorrow's gain or final land. The projected superior persona and its boast become a false proxy and forecast: an image asked to guarantee a self and future it cannot replace or know.

activation_trace.role: The imagined likeness supplies the proxy self presented to observers.
Semblance and uncertainty keep that proxy from becoming reliable identity.
The merit ledger supplies a narrative that projects past prestige into future security.
One thing standing in for another supplies the substitution that the verse explicitly denies between persons.
Attractive but unstable deception describes how a polished persona gains credit.
Unknown consequence and hazard expose the boast's false confidence in outcome.
The branch image of a human face makes worldly life unexpectedly echo the focus's public face.
Knowledge explicitly withheld from the self bounds every confident self-narration.
The non-dominant mapped branch of road-direction supplies a form-distant spatial echo of an unknowable route.
Tomorrow supplies the near future that the displayed persona cannot secure.

structural_cues: 31:33 removes interpersonal substitution and warns against worldly deception; 31:34 repeats that no self knows its next acquisition or terminal place.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed substitution, deceptive appearance, and unknown trajectory; I infer that the focus persona is used as both proxy and forecast. The alternative is that the late warnings concern eschatological deception without targeting ordinary self-presentation.

changed_reading.before: Arrogance is an excessive estimate of one's present worth.
changed_reading.after: Arrogance installs a polished image and merit-story as substitutes for the accountable self and as guarantees of a route whose next gain and endpoint remain unknown.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The pupil-image branch is surprising and not the ordinary sense of people, but it remains anchored to the focus roots for people, cheek, and imagined likeness. Downstream prose should present this only as a visual branch analogy, not as a translation or settled lexical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: People can branch to the human image in an eye, while the proud predicate branches to an imagined likeness and the cheek supplies the turned surface.

activation_trace.role: The human figure reflected in the pupil makes another person's gaze a possible mirror.
The imagined likeness supplies the self-image preferred over reciprocal reflection.
The literal cheek-turn supplies the action that exits the other's visual field.

changed_reading.before: The proud person refuses to look at others.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the person refuses the corrective mirror of another's pupil while walking inside a self-authored image.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The class, track, cutting, and scattering branches are remote from the ordinary cheek sense, yet all belong to focus-root inventories and form a coherent social-spatial mechanism. Render it as a secondary topology of arrogance, never as direct lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The cheek root also carries class, path, and cutting branches, while the tilting root can scatter a herd and the people root supplies the collective.

activation_trace.role: A layer or class of people supplies the ranked partition produced by status display.
Path and track supply the shared route on which partition becomes visible.
Cutting supplies the inferred severance of a common social track.
Scattering a herd supplies dispersion as the consequence of the tilted relation.
Human collectivity supplies what is divided and dispersed.

changed_reading.before: A proud gesture insults individual bystanders.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it cuts a shared path into ranked human layers and scatters the collectivity that ordinary face-to-face movement could hold together.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a highly branch-distant material analogy assembled from the focus's waterskin, filling, jar, and pottery images. Its anchor is inspectable, but downstream prose must qualify it as a possible pressure-and-container model rather than a meaning of the surface words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exultation, love, and boast roots unexpectedly share a vessel network involving wetting a new skin, filling with water, a large jar, and fired clay.

activation_trace.role: Filling and wetting a new waterskin until its seams close supplies an unseasoned container under pressure.
Drinking or filling to repletion supplies the internal pressure of excess.
The great jar supplies the containing body that the pressure inhabits.
Fired pottery supplies the hardened and potentially brittle exterior of boast.

changed_reading.before: Pride is pictured chiefly as height or expansion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, pride is an overfilled, prematurely hardened vessel: inner excess becomes outward strain, and boast is the brittle shell that makes the pressure audible.

strongest_changes: The cheek-turn became chosen sensory closure rather than a merely impolite angle.
The focus was bracketed into resolute but measured motion, ruling out stillness as the remedy for pride.
Submitted face and secure grasp supplied a possible basis for remaining socially face-open without seeking rank.
Boast shifted from loud self-esteem to gift misaccounting, deceptive proxy, and false forecast.
Cosmic, marine, and land courses rescaled walking as bounded and enabled movement rather than autonomous mastery.
summary.what_was_special: Branch crossings made the cheek a track, prevented sway a strutting gait, outward blessing an object of boast, worldly life a face, and the split د ر ي inventory both knowledge and road-direction. These preserved social, spatial, ecological, performative, and epistemic readings without merging them.
remaining_uncertainties: The counterfeit-growth and vessel-pressure models may be productive cross-domain resonances rather than intended semantic activation.
The vertical whole-face versus horizontal cheek distinction from 31:22 is coherent but inferential.
The cosmic and marine course model may rescale the focus walk only analogically, especially because moderation in 31:32 is predicative rather than an explicit gait modifier.
